SaveApplying: The changes are being applied to the library in the background.
GenresHelp: Choose what becomes of each genre: keep it, rename it, merge it into another genre (it then appears under it) or remove it. Changes only apply after saving, check them in the Preview tab. Genres appearing later (new imports) are kept until you change them, and items with locked genres are never changed.
RemoveConfirm: Remove the genre "{genre}" (and the genres merged into it) from {count} items?
PreviewHelp: The changes the current settings, including the unsaved ones, would make to the items.
CommitHashHelp: Optional, for testing. Loads the web files of the plugin (settings page and translations) from this commit of the GitHub repository instead of the ones bundled with the plugin. Leave empty in normal use.
ResetHelp: Restores the original genres (the ones given by the metadata providers) of the items changed by the plugin, without changing any other metadata, and resets the settings so every genre is kept. The genres changed since by something else are left as they are.
ResetConfirm: Restore the original genres of the items and reset the settings?
ResetStarted: The original genres are being restored in the background.
